title: Araghchi Pays Tribute to Martyrs Qasem Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis
text:
Araghchi Pays Tribute to Martyrs Qasem Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis"

"🔆🔅Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi, upon arriving in Baghdad on Saturday, October 17, 2026, visited the site where Qasem Soleimani and Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis were martyred and paid tribute to them.
